text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival has arrived.
As for the event Hishi Amazon is entering—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here it is!
The main event: a pride-on-the-line curry showdown
between the Miho and Ritto Dorm Heads!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please look at the monitor!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, am I on camera?
Alright, here goes—*ahem*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm Hishi Amazon, big sis and dorm leader of Miho Dorm, in the flesh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: With Miho's pride on the line in this one-on-one, there's no way I'm backing down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but I simply cannot afford to lose today, either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The prize for winning is carrot ice cream for the whole dorm...
There are tons of little ponies looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah!
You're wonderful even through a screen, Fuji-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~! Big sis Hishi Ama, show 'em
what your real skills look like!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, our judge is this Umamusume!
Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you...!

Amidst immense excitement,
the curry cook-off began!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ora ora ora ora!
Let's keep slicin' 'em up!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Dorm Leader Hishi Ama chops through a massive pile
of carrots at an incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we gotta prepare a ton
for Oguri-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I cook for the Miho kids all the time! Something like this is a piece of cake!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this is sure to leave Judge Oguri Cap
thoroughly satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, but Dorm Leader Fuji's response is...
Look at that incredible array of spices!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, beautiful knife skills, Hishiama.
I'm sure you'll whip up a delicious curry.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Going head-on against someone like you
leaves no chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So this time... allow me to add a little spice.
Quite literally, that is."

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Familiar Japanese curry rice versus spicy Indian curry...!
This is turning into quite the contest!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Both dishes are complete, and the curry is being
brought out to the venue! Ahh, what a wonderful aroma!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hearty enough to satisfy any growing appetite—it's a mega-sized chunky vegetable curry topped with fried chicken!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's an Indian curry with a custom blend of spices. I've also prepared a salad, lassi, and cheese naan.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Even though they give off completely opposite vibes, both are equally charming!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Now then, bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap silently shovels curry into her mouth!
Just what will it take to satisfy her appetite—!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's a draw!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What an unexpected development!
What could Oguri Cap be thinking... !?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Both are delicious. Both are warm.
So I can't put one above the other...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"This is an unexpected turn of events!
Cries of bewilderment are rising from the stands as well—?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No! In a contest, the judges' word is absolute!
If it's a draw, then we accept the draw gracefully!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I got to have a great one-on-one showdown.
I'm thoroughly satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I think I agree with Hishi Ama's opinion.
There's no need to force a conclusion."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about we split
this carrot ice cream in half?
Thanks to the positive attitude of the two dorm heads, there wasn't a single boo from the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal, both of you.

Wrapped in a warm atmosphere,
the curry showdown came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Oguri Cap took a bite of
Dorm Leader Hishi Ama's curry and froze completely!
What does this mean—?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This flavor... tastes just like the curry from Masae,
the home-style diner back in my hometown...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Large carrots, crispy stir-fried
chunks of meat, soy-sauce flavored fried chicken...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
I wonder how Masae-san is doing...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: And Oguri Cap sheds a tear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not really sure what happened, but... I'm glad to see you're feeling better!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat up!
There's plenty more where that came from!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Masae-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahaha! As expected, I really
can't match that. I admit defeat.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama's kind heart must have
brought back those precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't really planning
on winning like this, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, but... not bad at all!
And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival ended with great success.

Later on, "Masae-san's Curry" made a limited-time
appearance on the academy cafe's menu—
but that's a story for another time.
